environment.description: Same application deployed behind CloudFront distribution (ID: E2XYZABC123) with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy restricting origin to accept only requests bearing valid CloudFront-signed headers (x-origin-verify with rotating HMAC). The origin security group restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. CloudFront behavior configured with cache policy 'CachingDisabled' and origin request policy 'AllViewerExceptHostHeader'. Critically, the CloudFront distribution has a custom response headers policy (ID: 67f8-ab12-policy) that strips and regenerates all Set-Cookie headers with __Host- prefix enforcement and SameSite=Strict attribute injection at the edge, meaning any cookie set by the origin without __Host- prefix is rewritten. Additionally, the CloudFront function (CF2 runtime) on viewer-request event validates that no tf_session cookie is present on requests to /login endpoint — if detected, the cookie is stripped from the forwarded request before it reaches origin. The function ARN is arn:aws:cloudfront::123456789012:function/StripSessionOnLogin.

config.function_behavior: viewer-request: strips tf_session cookie on /login path before forwarding
config.response_headers_policy: 67f8-ab12-policy: injects SameSite=Strict, rewrites cookies to __Host- prefix
config.direct_origin_access: blocked by security group + OAC verification
